name: mainline_query_channels_v1
status: complete:27 original query replays,18 channel stages,3 native frozen controls and cached truth summary
role: Fixed-trajectory query diagnosis on already opened shared-neighborhood cases; no new optimizer or deployed reward.

frozen_assets.reuse: Load frozen native prior, GP/structural bundle, public mean10/learned risk10 representation, eight source identities and 1024 source integration nodes. Reuse the parent STOP initial10 raw in original order. No source simulation, fitting, encoder fitting or download.

initialization: All controls share the full posterior after original ten raw observations. Only adaptive observations at paid prefixes11/12 are intervened on.
replay: Reuse all13 saved raw in original order. Reproduce three candidate pools, complete scores, selections and raw; capture actual pre-score RNG; stop after supplying third query raw before final update/terminal.

controls.full: Recorded full posterior and actual TS draw.
controls.no_cross_noise: Use initial10 noise for unobserved policies; for subsequently observed points, condition initial10 on only that point subsequent raw. Full means, covariance and draws retained.
controls.no_cross_mean: Own-point after-initial10 f/g means; retain full epistemic covariance and full noise. Same Gaussian draw residual: draw_full-mean_full+mean_own.
controls.no_cross_mean_noise: Combine the previous two marginal interventions, retaining full epistemic covariance.
controls.no_cross_all_fixed_correlation: Own-point means/variance/noise with initial10 inter-policy correlation, C_cf=D C10 D where D=sqrt(var_own/var10). Use original pre-call RNG and bank order. This is a diagnostic fixed-correlation moment control, not a native joint posterior; it avoids the product control independently deleting all inter-policy correlation.
controls.frozen10: Keep initial10 full posterior, same actual pool/observed set and pre-score RNG; no adaptive posterior update.
controls.native_frozen10: Freeze native objective/constraint/HVD/expert models at initial10, retaining original scorer and each actual candidate pool/observed set and same pre-score RNG. All three seeds, not only successful case.

policy_local_conditioning: Initial10 full moments on current bank. For each unique post-initialization sampled policy restore only initial10 plus that policy adaptive raw on the small bank containing its required history; replace only its own marginal. Unobserved policy marginals stay at initial10.
checks: Full replay must reproduce ordered candidates, all saved score fields and selected raw. Reconstructed TS full draws/scores must match saved score and first-query controls match full before subsequent comparisons. Keep original precision and record failures.

barriers.before_counterfactuals: Register this protocol before recovery or counterfactual computation.
barriers.before_truth: Freeze all nine recovery files and six GP/structure channel files before truth scoring. Reuse existing truth; evaluate only missing selected counterfactual policies analytically, record calls. No oracle-driven branch/model selection.

limitations: One-step counterfactuals condition on the actual paid history; their selections cannot inherit subsequent raw or actual verification/deployment rewards.
Same arm RNG is paired; native expert draws and GP/structure finite-bank draws have different dimensions, so random variables are not matched across backends.
The fixed-correlation control preserves initial dependence while removing adaptive cross-policy changes in moments; it is a diagnostic construction, not a learned replacement model.
